items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Well I can remember Morris from a long time back when I was a kid. And he played, most of the bands he played, he played with Randy for I guess about 20 years or maybe better.

ctx.x: Your uncle Morris? No, Johnny was next. And then Morris and then he had another brother that's younger. He doesn't play the music.
Doesn't play the music. We have an interview with your uncle Morris. You did? Dick Allen was up and saw him. Fine. Oh, about three weeks ago or so.
